'''Massa di Requiem per Shuggay''' is a [[unique item]].  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion.

==Card info==
'''Type''': [[Tome]]

'''Movement''': Exhaust and spend 4 [[movement]] points to make a [[Will check|Will (-2) check]].  If you pass, discard Massa di Requiem per Shuggay, and the [[Ancient One]] immediately awakens.  If you fail, nothing happens.

'''Price''': $4

==Mythos Source==
Massa di Requiem per Shuggay first appeared in the Call of Cthulhu RPG supplement ''Mysterious Manuscripts'' (1991).
